tags.description: A half-kilo box of little elbows, every one of them identical, pressed out by a machine that has been pressing out elbows since before the Handoff and has never been asked to do anything else. There's a cartoon child on the front holding a bowl, drawn in a style nobody has drawn in for sixty years. It cooks up honest enough, which is the most anyone says about it.
